Re: The Diamond

May I recommend Brian Conway’s recording (track 11 on his CD Wallace Avenue), starting at about 2:40.
Brian also played this beautifully here at a session in San Francisco at the Plough (4/12/2026). From my review of the versions here, Brian’s recording matches very nicely with X:1 with just a few added flourishes.

Great tune by Billy, and very tasteful playing by Brian.
